creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`FindBar` reaches the core two ways: its needle goes through the injected dispatcher and its step goes through the `Core.dispatcher` global. That is how `Core.*` statics work throughout the shell, so it is not one view's bug.

It made a test in `a_2JrhrSBOx` flaky until the author stopped awaiting between setting the global and using it. Every parallel test in the Swift suite is exposed to the same race, and the symptom is a flake that looks like the feature under test.

Worth a card about the pattern rather than about `FindBar`: either the statics get a per-test scope, or the suite says which tests may not run in parallel.
title: 🧵 Every parallel Swift test races the Core.* statics
